newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Illegal immigrants drown off Moroccan coast.
newsitem.headline: Illegal immigrants drown off Moroccan coast.

text.p: Fourteen Moroccan illegal immigrants drowned on their way to Spain after their makeshift boat sank off the Moroccan coast, a daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
L'Opinion said the 14 would-be immigrants died late last week after their boat was wrecked off the coast of the northern city of Tangier. The last body was washed ashore on Saturday.
It said police were still looking for three people -- the boat's owner and two would-be immigrants -- who are thought to have survived.
Hundreds of Moroccans and nationals of other African countries try each year to reach Europe illegally in makeshift boats

Late last year, a Moroccan fisherman was jailed for four years after 26 would-be immigrants he was shipping to Spain drowned. He was the only survivor. Each of his passengers had paid him 4,000 dirhams ($420) for the trip.
Morocco and Belgium agreed on Monday to strengthen cooperation in the fight against illegal immigration and other problems, such as drug trafficking.
